speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park has significantly affected the fishing grounds used by Arcadian communities.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The turbines make traditional bottom-trawling impossible in this area.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Without an alternative, many fishing families will struggle to maintain their livelihoods.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: At the same time, the current location can create opportunities for marine habitats if the area is managed carefully.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia therefore has to decide whether to adapt the fishing environment around the wind park or reconsider the location of the project.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: How should Arcadia address the impact on the fishing communities?
